message:
The other night, we had a little scare when a storm rolled through, and the power flickered out. Instead of panicking, we decided to turn it into a cozy family event. We gathered our go-bags, grabbed some flashlights, and snuggled up on the couch with blankets and snacks. We played card games and shared stories by candlelight, turning what could have been a stressful situation into a memorable evening. 

It reminded us that being prepared doesn’t have to feel heavy or daunting; it can also be a chance to bond and create warmth in unexpected moments. What’s a way you’ve turned a tricky situation into a cozy experience?
